fields.description: Issue dated Oct. 13, 1928, featuring editorials and local commentary on alleged political interference and patient care at Jackson Memorial Hospital; anticipated winter tourist season in Miami; criticism of Coral Gables commission actions including the forced resignation of transportation superintendent Arthur M. Mack and concerns about city management; discussion of Hialeah civic and financial disputes; hurricane relief and skepticism about Red Cross administration; notes on Lake Okeechobee flood-control advocacy; Prohibition-era liquor trade and price listings; a Flagler Street dry-cleaning plant bombing tied to price disputes; and assorted local society items, entertainment notices, and advertising (including neon signage).
